output.scope_note: The paper reports proton conductivities of a protonated brownmillerite oxide (HSrCoO2.5) measured by impedance spectroscopy, so it is about a solid ion conductor with numeric conductivity values.

records.synthesis_method: pulsed laser deposition of SrCoO2.5 thin films followed by ionic liquid gating protonation
records.evidence_quote: the low-temperature ionic conductivity of HSCO, being 0.028 S•cm-1 and 0.33 S•cm-1
records.notes: Proton conductivity of thin-film HSCO (protonated SrCoO2.5 film). The 140 oC value (0.33) is not recorded, per the lowest-temperature rule. Activation energy 0.27 eV is from the main text for HSCO.

records.synthesis_method: pulsed laser deposition of SrCoO2.5 thin films followed by ionic liquid gating protonation
records.evidence_quote: the proton conductivity at 60 oC can be estimated as 0.051 S•cm-1
records.notes: ILG-induced HSCO sample, value from the equivalent-circuit fit of a single spectrum. Recorded as a separate spot value, not part of the main Arrhenius series, so it is a secondary record.

records.evidence_quote: the proton conductivity of this compound is limited to a notable value of ~0.01 S•cm-1 at the intermediate temperature region (~500 oC)
records.notes: Value for protonated nickelate HSmNiO3 taken from prior work (Ref. 14), not measured in this paper. Included only because it is a stated conductivity number; the temperature is approximate.
